---
title: "SES Achievement Gaps"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source(here::here("R/site_helpers.R"))
```

The gap between the average scores of High SES and Low SES students in each district.
Larger bars mean a wider achievement gap. Gray bars are the **National public** and **Large city** comparison groups.
Districts where either estimate was not reported are omitted.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Grade 4 Mathematics

```{r}
ses_gap_chart("Mathematics", 4)
```

## Grade 8 Mathematics

```{r}
ses_gap_chart("Mathematics", 8)
```

```{r}
ses_gap_chart("Reading", 8)
```

:::


::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
The NAEP API returns point estimates only, without standard errors, so differences between
districts shown here have not been tested for statistical significance. Use the
[NAEP Data Explorer](https://www.nationsreportcard.gov/ndecore/xplore/NDE) for significance testing.
:::
